newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone rings up 13 pct rise in yr profits.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone rings up 13 pct rise in yr profits.

text.p: British mobile phone company Vodafone Group Plc said on Tuesday its annual profits grew 13 percent, boosted by a strong performance from its international operations.
Vodafone said its pretax profit rose to a record 539 million pounds ($880.8 million) for the year ended on March 31 from 475 million in the previous year.
The results were in line with analysts' expectations, which ranged from 525 to 543 million pounds, after a 25 million pound gain on disposals.
Vodafone proposed a final dividend of 2.45 pence per share, making a total of 4.81 for the year, up 20 percent from the previous year.
Vodafone's shares eased 4.0 pence to 267.5 pence by 1300 GMT.
Vodafone said it had good subscriber growth in Britain, where new customers rose 17 percent to 2.87 million.
However, average revenue per customer fell 11.2 percent to 427 pounds.
The company said it had strong growth in overseas subscribers, who made up 28 percent of the group's total, up from 20 percent a year earlier.

"For the first time, our international operations, taken as a whole, achieved an operating profit and customer growth overseas exceeded that in the UK," chief executive Chris Gent said in the earnings statement. ($ = 0.611 British Pounds)
